about: CROSSFADE use cases, drawn from the Project 1 requirements analysis (RA). Each evidence phrase is quoted word for word from the RA block it cites; build_usecases.py fails if one is not found. 'columns' = every column the use case needs. 'single' = how far a non-associative table answers it alone (full or partial); 'singleColumns' = the columns that single-table part reads, when different. 'expectsError' marks a use case whose correct outcome is an error raised by the database.
